description: This file defines the DiscardLayoutChangesForm class, a Drupal form used to discard unsaved layout changes within the layout builder module.

classes.name: Drupal ormat_builder orm\DiscardLayoutChangesForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for discarding unsaved layout changes in the layout builder module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for layout tempstore repository and messenger service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question for discarding changes.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description message, including entity label if available.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Returns URL to cancel and go back to layout builder.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, attaching admin path settings.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission to delete layout changes and redirect.
